meta.note: Manual evidence-class corrections. Entries here override the automated result of scripts/classify_evidence_classes.py; each carries the reason a reviewer disagreed with the heuristic. Add entries as {"id", "evidence_class", "note"}; IDs must exist in the curated catalog.
meta.review_pass: 2026-10-31: reviewed every Class 0/1 case-study boundary assignment against the recorded descriptions and signals.
meta.policy: Whole-product reconstructions (native ports of a complete game, complete matching decompilations, static recompilations of a shipped release) with download, demo and full docs count as Class 0 even when the description's wording ('builds a port') matches the partial-scope heuristic.
